parameters.content:
## 🎯 MARKETING ATTRIBUTION & LEAD ENGINE
**What it does:** Webhook lead intake → normalize + dedupe by phone/email → AI scores every lead 0–100 (Hot/Warm/Cold) → round-robin rep assignment → WhatsApp outreach to Hot leads → every touch logged to Google Sheets. A second daily branch pulls Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn/YouTube ad spend, computes CPL, CPLPV, CPP and ROAS per channel, and alerts on Telegram when a channel's CPL blows past your cap.

**You'll need:**
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com)
- Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials
- Telegram bot token + your chat ID (@BotFather → /newbot)
- Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn/YouTube ad-account access + tokens (for the attribution branch)
- A WhatsApp HTTP API endpoint (e.g. WAHA) for Hot-lead outreach

**Status flow in Sheets:** `NEW` → `SCORED` → `ASSIGNED` → `CONTACTED` (returning leads flip to `TOUCHED`; low scores go to `NURTURE`)

## STEP 1 — Webhook lead intake + normalize
Form/landing page POSTs name, email, phone, UTM tags and message → config (rep roster, thresholds, WhatsApp URL) → normalize email/phone/UTM.

## STEP 2 — Dedupe + log to Google Sheets
Read the Leads sheet → match on phone or email. Returning lead: flip status to `TOUCHED` + log a Journey touchpoint. New lead: append with status `NEW`.

## STEP 3 — AI lead scoring
AI Agent (gpt-4o-mini + Structured Output Parser) scores 0–100 and assigns a tier: Hot / Warm / Cold. Sheet flips to `SCORED`.

## STEP 4 — Round-robin assignment + WhatsApp
Hot leads go to the senior rep (first in the roster) + instant WhatsApp. Warm leads rotate round-robin across reps. Cold leads go to `NURTURE`. Every touch is logged to the Journey sheet.

## STEP 5 — Lead alert
All branches merge → one Telegram alert with score, tier, channel, campaign and assigned rep.

## STEP 6 — Daily attribution branch (08:00)
Schedule trigger → fetch Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn/YouTube spend → join with Leads/Journey sheets → compute CPL, CPLPV, CPP, ROAS per channel → append a daily snapshot → Telegram alert for any channel over the CPL cap. Ad-fetch nodes have Continue On Fail ON: an unconfigured channel reports spend 0 instead of killing the run.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a senior sales-qualification analyst. Score this inbound lead 0-100 for buying intent and fit.

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
{{ $('CONFIG — AI Scoring').first().json.business_context }}

Scoring guidance: a real name + business email + specific message about a real need scores high; vague one-liners, free-mail throwaways, gibberish or obvious spam score low. Hot = 70+, Warm = 40-69, Cold = below 40. Output ONLY via the structured output parser.

}
